system.description: The past is a blank slate: you know nothing of your history, family, friends or foes. The Storyteller invents your character's background and the reason for the amnesia, and may keep part of your sheet hidden, revealing your Abilities, Disciplines, Merits and Flaws only as you try to use them. In general, the only things obvious to you are what you can see in the mirror.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
